home_description: With Urbain Clean, every action counts. Report, act, and together let's build a clean, healthy, and proud city.
home_citizens_text: Joined by over {{count}} committed citizens for a cleaner city
home_why_subtitle: Simple tools for concrete actions and a positive impact on our daily lives.
home_feature1_desc: Report a cleanliness issue in just a few seconds.
home_feature2_desc: Follow the status of your report at every step.
home_feature3_desc: Every citizen contributes to keeping our city clean.
home_feature4_desc: Together, let's build a cleaner and more sustainable city.
home_mission_desc: A clean and sustainable city for all
home_cta_desc: Join hundreds of citizens already improving their city.
how_subtitle: A simple, transparent process for every citizen
how_step1_desc: Create your free account in seconds – choose 'Citizen' as your role.
how_step2_desc: Take a photo, describe the issue, and pinpoint the location. Your report is instantly shared.
how_step3_desc: The system assigns your report to the nearest available field agent.
how_step4_desc: Track progress in real time, get notified when resolved, and rate your satisfaction.
about_subtitle: Our mission is to create cleaner, more sustainable cities through citizen engagement.
about_mission_desc: To empower every citizen to actively participate in keeping their city clean by providing simple, transparent, and effective reporting tools.
about_value4_desc: Using technology to solve real problems.
about_team_desc: A passionate group of developers, urban planners, and environmental advocates working together for a cleaner future.
contact_subtitle: We'd love to hear from you. Send us a message and we'll respond as soon as possible.

please_complete_captcha: Please complete the reCAPTCHA verification to prove you're human.
contact_error: Failed to send message. Please try again later.
how_step1_detail1: Choose your role (Citizen, Agent, or Manager) during sign-up
how_step1_detail2: Profile automatically created with your email and name
how_step1_detail3: Start reporting issues immediately after verification
how_step2_detail1: Take a photo (the app compresses it automatically to save space)
how_step2_detail2: Select the type of problem: illegal dumping, full container, graffiti, bulky items
how_step2_detail3: Pin the exact location on the map or use your current GPS position
how_step3_detail1: Our AI assigns the report to the nearest available field agent
how_step3_detail2: You receive a confirmation notification with the agent's name
how_step3_detail3: The report status changes to 'In progress' automatically
how_step4_detail1: Follow the resolution step by step in real time
how_step4_detail2: Rate the quality of the intervention (satisfaction score)
how_step4_detail3: Your feedback helps improve our service for everyone
how_benefit1_desc: You know exactly who is handling your report and when it will be resolved.
how_benefit2_desc: Push notifications and live status keep you informed at every stage.
how_benefit3_desc: Each report contributes to a cleaner, healthier city for everyone.
how_benefit4_desc: No hidden fees – our service is 100% free for citizens.
